Method of Attack: Backdoor capable of downloading other malware onto an infected device
Masquerades as an adult player app or MMS application without their functionality
Listens to a predetermined Twitter account at regular intervals for encrypted commands
Commands include instructions to install banking malware/ransomware or switch to a new Twitter C&C account
Attack Vector: SMS or malicious URLs spreading disguised malicious app
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Twitter account as command-and-control (C&C) server
Encrypted messages on Twitter for commands
Malicious app impersonating porn player or MMS app not found on official Android app stores
